dedupe_keys.name: live bulk supply point operational metering 30 day

description: Live Bulk Supply Point Operational Metering 30 Day is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. Our Bulk Supply Point (BSP) Operational Metering contains live data on the power flows through each of our BSPs. Specifically, this is the active power, measured in kilowatts at half‑hourly intervals for each of our BSPs, which are substations that converts voltage from one EHV Voltage (132, 66 or 33kV) to another EHV voltage. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Network. Its keywords are Live Data, Extra High Voltage (EHV), Transformer, EHV Substation Data. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0 (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/opendatalicence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
